verdict.rationale: Belvo is a SaaS open-finance API that processes sensitive user data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training on customer data, an opt-out control, or a data-use policy covering model training. The MCP, llms.txt and 'Copy for LLM' items concern AI tooling access, not training-data controls, and the community security comments are off-topic.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
